technical.summary: Bullish technical setup with strong moving average alignment and volume confirmation, but weakened by negative MACD histogram, low ADX trend strength, and poor accumulation signals—suitable for swing entry with caution on overbought conditions.

fundamental.summary: RSG shows no fundamental conviction signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 8 days present elevated volatility risk with no offsetting smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral overall signal.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (435.2), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent earnings create a highly adverse macro backdrop for RSG trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: SMA 9/21 golden cross with three white soldiers and 15x volume spike provide classic bullish technical confirmation at support level (126.71), offering defined risk entry for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Crisis-level VIX (435.2), imminent earnings in 8 days, zero fundamental conviction, negative MACD histogram, weak ADX trend strength, and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create a hostile macro environment that overwhelms technical signals.

decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 8 days combined with crisis-level macro conditions (VIX 435.2, inverted yield curve, rising dollar) creates uncompensated tail risk that negates technical edge.
